post.description: Queue a call from an instant-mode employee to one person. The employee's own number, calling hours and retry ladder apply, exactly as for a lead from your lead webhook. 201 = a new call; 200 = the same person was already queued with this employee in the last few minutes, and that call is returned.

get.description: Includes every attempt and, once the person was reached, the result with transcript and a recording link valid for one hour.

post.description: 201 = added; 200 = it was already on the list. Calls to it stop at once, including ones already queued.
Cancel a call that has not started dialling (queued, scheduled or on hold). A call already ringing or connected cannot be cancelled.
Starts calling (or waits for scheduled_at / a free slot: at most 3 campaigns run at once). The first launch needs `consent.confirmed: true`, recorded against this API key.
Stops new calls; calls in progress finish. Resume to continue.
Continues a paused campaign (or queues it if 3 campaigns are already running).
Ends the campaign. People not called yet are kept and can be called later from the dashboard.
We POST each event you subscribe to, signed with the returned secret.
Returns a new secret. For 24 hours each delivery also carries X-Outpero-Signature-Previous, signed with the old one, so you can switch over without missing a message.
Sends a sample event (marked test: true) now and returns the result.

held_credits.title: Held Credits
held_credits.description: Credits set aside for calls in progress.

source.title: Source
source.description: api, lead_webhook, dashboard, callback or test.

status_detail.title: Status Detail
status_detail.description: Why it is waiting or why it ended, in plain words.

Call.title: Call
Call.description:
One call request to one person. It may take several attempts (the retry ladder); `result`
is the latest conversation.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: The number to call, in any Indian format: 10 digits, or starting 0, 91 or +91.

name.title: Name
name.description: The person's name, available to the script.

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: Values for the employee's call variables, by key (GET /employees/{id} lists them).

external_id.title: External Id
external_id.description: Your own reference, echoed back on reads and webhooks; filter with GET /calls?external_id=.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Up to 20 keys of your own, echoed back.

scheduled_at.title: Scheduled At
scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 time to call (up to 7 days ahead). Calling hours still apply.

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Run every check and say what would happen, without placing the call.

status.title: Status
status.description: The status the call would start in.

connected.title: Connected
connected.description: True when the person picked up and the employee spoke with them.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: qualified, interested, callback, not_interested, missed, no_answer, busy, call_failed or voicemail.

captured.title: Captured
captured.description: Answers the employee collected, keyed by your capture fields.

ended_by.title: Ended By
ended_by.description: Who ended the call: agent, customer, or a technical reason.

recording_url.title: Recording Url
recording_url.description: A link to the recording, valid for one hour. Only on single-object requests.

callback_at.title: Callback At
callback_at.description: When the person asked to be called back, if they did.

CallResult.title: CallResult
CallResult.description:
What happened on a conversation. The same shape on calls, leads, campaign contacts and in
webhook events.

key.title: Key
key.description: Send this key in `variables` when you place a call.

role.title: Role
role.description: phone = the number dialled; name = the person's name.

status.title: Status
status.description: draft, scheduled, queued, live, paused or completed.

display_status.title: Display Status
display_status.description: What it is really doing: also retries_scheduled or stopped.

buckets.title: Buckets
buckets.description: Every contact in exactly one group: waiting_first_call, calling_now, connected, retry_scheduled, no_answer_final, could_not_call, stopped_not_called, stopped_after_calls, skipped.

calling_window.title: Calling Window
calling_window.description: "HH:MM-HH:MM" in the campaign's timezone. Always kept within 09:00–21:00.

scheduled_at.title: Scheduled At
scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 start time; launch first, it waits until then.

consent.description: Required on a campaign's first launch.

confirmed.title: Confirmed
confirmed.description: You confirm these contacts agreed to be called and their data may be used.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the consent came from, e.g. 'website form'.

unmapped_keys.title: Unmapped Keys
unmapped_keys.description: Variable keys you sent that the employee has no field for, with counts.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: instant = calls single leads (POST /calls); bulk = runs campaigns; inbound = answers calls.

url.title: Url
url.description: An https URL that accepts POST requests.

events.title: Events
events.description: Event types to receive, or ["*"] for all.

employee_ids.title: Employee Ids
employee_ids.description: Only events about these employees. Omit for all.

secret_hint.title: Secret Hint
secret_hint.description: The last characters of the signing secret.

secret_hint.title: Secret Hint
secret_hint.description: The last characters of the signing secret.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: The signing secret (whsec_…). Shown only now — store it safely.

call_id.title: Call Id
call_id.description: The call request it came from, when there is one.

Lead.title: Lead
Lead.description:
One conversation (or one final unanswered attempt) and its outcome — every channel: single
calls, campaigns and incoming calls.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Calls this number can carry at once.

ApiKey.description: Create a key on the Developers page of your Outpero dashboard.
